extracted.name: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto
extracted.description: This sun-dried tomato pesto is a blend of sun-dried tomatoes, basil, pine nuts, garlic, olive oil, and Parmesan for a rich and tasty pasta sauce or spread.
instruction_lines: Place sun-dried tomatoes in a bowl and cover with warm water for 5 minutes, or until tender.

Place sun-dried tomatoes, pine nuts, onion, basil, parsley, and garlic in a food processor or blender; process until well blended. Add crushed tomatoes, vinegar, red wine, and tomato paste; blend to desired consistency. Stir in olive oil and Parmesan cheese; season to taste.
